1. (1) This Act may be cited as the Institiut Teknologi
MARA Act 1976.

(2) This Act shall come into force on such date as the
Minister may by notification in the Gazette appoint, such
date not being earlier than the date on which the notification
is published.

10. The Institiut shall, subject to the provisions of this Act,
have power to do anything, and to enter into any transaction,
which in its opinion is calculated to facilitate the proper
discharge of its duties or the performance of its functions
or the exercise of its powers under this Act or is incidental
or conducive thereto.

11. The Institiut may employ and pay agents and technical
advisers, including advocates and solicitors or other persons,
to transact its business or to do any act required to be
transacted or done in the execution of its duties or for the
better carrying into effect the purposes of this Act.

12. In addition to the duties imposed upon and the powers
vested in the Institiut by this Act, the Institiut may under-
take such other functions, exercise such other powers, and
administer and expend such other moneys, as the Minister
may assign or give to it, for such purposes as the Minister
may specify, and in so doing the Institiut shall be deemed
to be fulfilling the purposes of this Act and the provisions
of this Act shall apply to the Institiut in respect of such
functions, such powers and the administration and expend-
ing of such moneys:

Provided always that the accounts of such moneys shall
be kept separate and apart from those of the Fund.

14. (1) The Majlis shall be the executive body of the
Institiut and may exercise all the powers conferred on the
Institiut, save as otherwise provided by this Act or by any
rules or other subsidiary legislation made thereunder.

(2) The functions of the Majlis shall include the carrying
on of all such activities and the doing of all such things as
are necessary or advantageous and proper for the govern-
ment, control and administration of the Institiut.

or restrictions as it thinks fit, delegate to any member or any
committee of its members the power and authority to carry

16. (1) For the purpose of enabling it to discharge its duties
and exercise its powers, the Majlis may, from time to time,
appoint such committees from jamongst its members as it
may consider necessary or desirable, and shall, in any case,
appoint the following committees :

(a) a Finance and Development Committee;
(b) an Academic Affairs Committee; and
(c) a Staff Affairs Committee.

(2) A committee established under subsection (1) shall
have the function of deliberating upon matters referred to
it by the Majlis and making appropriate recommendations
thereon to the Majlis.

(3) A committee established under subsection (1) may
appoint, where necessary, one or more sub-committees from
amongst its members, or it may co-opt such persons as can
contribute to its deliberations, but a person co-opted shall
not have the right to vote.

(4) The chairman of a committee established under sub-
section (1) shall be appointed by the Majlis or, where the
Majlis so directs, by the members of the committee from
amongst themselves.

24. (1) For the purpose of this Act there is hereby esta-
blished a Fund to be known as the Institiut Teknologi
MARA Fund which shall be administered and controlled
by the Majlis.

(2) The Fund shall consist of—

(a) such sums as may be provided from time to time by
Parliament;

(b) such sums as may from time to time be lent to the
Institiut by the Government;

(c) any voluntary gift to the Institiut;

(d)moneys earned by the operation of any project,
scheme or enterprise financed from the Fund;

(g) all other sums or property which may in any manner
become payable to or vested in the Institiut in
respect of any matter incidental to its powers,
functions and duties.

(3) All the moneys paid to the Institiut shall be applied
or expended by the Institiut for all or any of the purposes
of the Institiut in accordance with the estimates approved
by the Minister.

(4) It shall be the duty of the Majlis and the Director to
conserve the Fund by so exercising, performing and dis-
charging their powers, functions and duties under this Act
so as to secure that the total revenues of the Institiut are,
subject to any direction given by the Minister under section
29, sufficient to meet all sums properly chargeable to its
revenue account, taking one year with another.

26. (1) The Director shall, not later than April in each year, Annual
lay before the Majlis detailed estimates of revenue and "Umates

(2) A copy of such estimates shall be sent to each member

(3) The Majlis shall consider the estimates so submitted
and shall sanction the same either unaltered or subject to
such alteration as it thinks fit, and such alteration may
include the addition, modification or the rejection of any
item appearing in the estimates.

(4) The Majlis may before sanctioning the estimates under
subsection (3) refer any item back to the Director for his
re-consideration.
